scope: Device editing in the desktop; gain and transpose output oracles, persistence and live edits
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image, docker --network none, Qt offscreen platform
verified_behaviors: Chain order lists the MIDI stage first; moves stay within a stage; refusals for a move across the instrument, transpose on an audio track, out-of-range values, unknown IDs and kinds, a ninth device and more than +24 dB
Removing all devices restores the default chain; Undo brings back the same IDs; a later device gets a new ID

Gain: -6 dB and +3 dB devices scale the pulse export exactly as (0.7 * 10^(-6/20) * 10^(3/20)) * source; with a level ramp lane, (ramp * device) * source; Save/reopen keeps the binding and the samples

Transpose: +12 doubles zero crossings of a square A3 (165 -> 330 over 18000 frames) with the same onset, end and amplitude; +48 then +48 drops the note (silent export); Undo restores; Save/reopen exports identical audio
A transpose change while the note sounds is applied live; the voice finishes, the next loop sounds, and Stop leaves no voice
QML: + Gain, + Transpose (MIDI only), value boxes, move and remove buttons, Undo, and edits while playing
limits: Static device parameters per prepared plan; no device automation yet (#77); offscreen platform.
